searchCommands: Search for a command to run...

terminalBusy: Exit the full-screen program before running shortcuts
youWillNeedToSignInAgain: You will need to sign in again.
overviewDescription: Cluster health, account availability and service quality over the last hour
statisticsDescription: Request, spending and latency trends, with user, provider and model rankings
logsDescription: Request history with filtering, export and detailed views
gatewayWorkerDescription: Codex forwarding workers and capacity status
gatewayWorkerLoadFailed: Unable to load Gateway Worker status.
gatewayWorkerSharedStateRedis: Redis OK · shared leases {{leases}} · holds from other instances {{holds}}
gatewayWorkerFactsError: Failed to read the control-plane database
gatewayWorkerControlPlaneRedisHint: control-plane environment, inherited by the local Worker; see each instance's shared state for actual use
gatewayWorkerControlPlaneInvalidSwitch: configured value “{{value}}” is invalid; running with the value shown
gatewayWorkerControlPlaneInboxCounts: processed {{done}} · awaiting comparison {{pending}} · differences {{diff}} · failed or invalid {{failed}}
gatewayWorkerControlPlaneAmbiguous: {{account}} · {{grant}} outcome unknown on {{instance}}; other instances will not refresh before {{time}}
codexAccountsDescription: Manage Codex accounts, authorization, proxies, groups and scheduling
codexAccountsWorkerScheduling: Accounts are scheduled inside the Worker
codexCreateHelp: Choose a proxy and groups, then authorize. The first authorization creates the account.
codexEditHelp: Leave the proxy empty to keep the current one.
codexAuthorizeHelp: Reauthorization keeps the name, groups, proxy and capacity settings.
codexProjectionPending: Saved; some Workers have not synced. Check projection status.
codexNoGroups: Create an active OpenAI group with Codex models in Groups first.
codexInlineProxyHelp: A pasted proxy is added to the proxy pool and bound to this account; check it from the Proxy tab.
codexInlineProxyVendorHelp: For supplier accounts a pasted proxy is stored on this account only and is not added to the platform proxy pool.
codexProxyDescription: The Gateway Worker reaches OpenAI through this proxy. An account must keep an outbound proxy, so it can be switched but not unbound.
codexProxyNotPooled: This proxy was pasted manually and is not in the proxy pool, so it has no health, latency or exit location. Add it to the pool to probe it, check its location and include it in scheduled probes.
codexProxyPooled: Added to the proxy pool and bound to this account
codexNoWorker: No Gateway Worker is available. Check instances before authorization.
codexDraftLocked: Account settings are locked for this authorization draft. Close and reopen to change them.
codexEmpty: No Codex accounts yet. Create an account to authorize it.
codexResetCreditAutoHelp: Looks for available rate-limit reset credits daily and uses them before they expire; set the lead time and weekly cap in Settings → OpenAI
codexQuotaQueryFailed: Quota check failed. Check the credentials and proxy.
codexQuotaPartial: The reset-credit list is unavailable; the count comes from the usage endpoint.
codexResetCreditConfirm: Use one reset credit on “{{name}}” to reset its Codex usage windows now. This cannot be undone.
codexResetCreditDone: Reset credit used and quota refreshed
codexResetCreditFailed: The reset credit was not confirmed. Clicking again retries the same request and will not spend a second credit.
codexActionFailed: Account action failed. Check Worker status
codexArchiveConfirm: Archive “{{name}}” to stop new requests and remove group membership. Usage history and bills are retained.
codexDeleteConfirm: Permanently deleting “{{name}}” cannot be undone: the account is removed from every Gateway Worker, its credentials, proxy and group membership are cleared, and it no longer appears in any list, including archived. Usage history and settlements are retained. To stop new requests but keep the account, archive it instead.
codexDeletePending: Account deleted; some Gateway Workers are unreachable and will drop the account and its credentials once they reconnect
codexGatewayOAuthHelp: After authorizing, paste the full callback URL.
codexGatewayCallbackHelp: Use the account proxy {{proxy}} in your browser to authorize, then paste the full callback URL.
codexBulkDescription: {{count}} accounts selected; only checked fields change.
codexBulkHelp: Every account is validated before saving; if any fails, none is changed.
codexTestHelp: Send a real conversation with this account through the Gateway Worker to verify credentials, proxy egress and the Worker path.
codexTestCredential: Codex OAuth · Gateway Worker / OpenAI Responses (this account only)
codexWeightHelp: Weight 1–100; higher goes first. Only the highest-weight available accounts are picked.
codexWeightRange: Weight must be an integer from 1 to 100
codexModelAccessAllowHelp: Serve only the selected models (exact upstream model IDs).
codexModelAccessDenyHelp: Never serve the selected models; others are unaffected.
codexModelAccessSearch: Search or type a model ID and press Enter
codexModelAccessCleanupSelection: Choose models to remove from the allowlist
codexModelAccessCleanupHelp: These selected models are not in the current catalog; that alone does not mean they stopped working. Save the account to apply.
codexModelAccessCleanupKeepOne: Keep at least one model in the allowlist
codexModelAccessRequired: Pick at least one model for the allowlist or blocklist
codexProtectionAwaitingProbe: Freeze expired, waiting for a successful probe
codexProtectionHint: Rules are configured under account error protection in settings; Recover cooldown also lifts the freeze.
codexProfileUnavailable: The account profile is unavailable right now
gatewayWorkerSingleMode: Single-Worker mode: only one accepting Worker is allowed (deploy it next to the control plane), so account concurrency, RPM and cooldowns exist once. Drain or stop the old instance before replacing it; set KIN_CODEX_GATEWAY_MULTI_WORKER=1 to run several Workers.
gatewayWorkerMultiMode: Multi-Worker mode is on; one instance is accepting.
gatewayWorkerMultiActive: Multi-Worker mode: {{value}} instances are accepting. Account concurrency, RPM, cooldowns and error counts are kept per instance (the effective limit is roughly the configured value × instances); protection freezes are shared through heartbeats.
gatewayWorkerSupervisorRunning: Supervised by the control plane: Worker running
gatewayWorkerSupervisorBackoff: Supervised by the control plane: the Worker exited and is restarting with backoff (see [codex-gateway] lines in the control-plane log)
gatewayWorkerSupervisorMissingBinary: Supervised by the control plane: bin/kin-codex-gateway is missing, so the Worker cannot start
gatewayWorkerSupervisorMissingSecret: Supervised by the control plane: the internal token is missing, so the Worker cannot start
gatewayWorkerSupervisorIdle: Supervised by the control plane: waiting to start
codexBpsOAuthHelp: Generate a BPS (Excel add-in) authorization link and sign in with the same paid ChatGPT account as this account. The browser then stays on a bps.openai.com page; copy the full address and paste it here.
codexBpsCallbackHelp: Connect the browser through the account proxy {{proxy}} to authorize, then paste the full address of the bps.openai.com callback page here.
codexBpsImportInvalid: The BPS authorization file is not valid JSON
codexBpsImportHelp: Paste the Excel add-in authorization JSON (access_token, refresh_token, id_token). It must belong to the same ChatGPT account as this account.

codexBpsStatus.off: Authorized · off or no models selected

codexBpsUnblockConfirm: Unblock BPS for this account and clear its BPS cooldowns? If the upstream still rejects it, BPS will be blocked again.
codexBpsRecoveryStopped: Automatic recovery probes stopped for this block
codexTestStrict: Strict probe (exact model + tool round trip)
codexImportDescription: Import a JSON file created by “Export accounts file”: each account is created with its native authorization, and accounts with BPS also get their BPS authorization and settings.
codexImportFileInvalid: Choose a JSON file created by “Export accounts file”
codexImportProxyFromFile: Use the proxy from the file
codexExportConfirm: The file contains the native and BPS authorization tokens of the selected accounts in plain text; anyone with the file can use these accounts. Export?
codexBpsBulkModelsPlaceholder: Model IDs, separated by commas or spaces
codexBpsBulkModelsInvalid: BPS models must be up to 100 exact model IDs (no wildcards)
codexBpsBulkModelsRequired: Enter the BPS models to add or remove
codexBpsBulkHelp: Only accounts with a BPS authorization are changed; others are reported individually. Set the 403 group move per account.
codexBpsRevokeConfirm: Revoke this account's BPS authorization? BPS settings are kept for the next authorization.
codexBpsHelp: BPS (Excel Basispoints) is an additional authorization on the account. After authorizing, select models: their requests try BPS first and fall back to the native channel on failure.
codexBpsEnabledHelp: When off, every request of this account uses the native channel; the authorization is kept.
codexBpsModelsHelp: Only selected models use BPS (up to 100); other models keep using the native channel. Images are uploaded as BPS attachments, and continuing a previous BPS response expands the full history on the same account. Selecting gpt-image-2 also sends image generations and edits to BPS first.
codexBpsCatalogNone: The official BPS model catalog has not been fetched yet.
codexBpsCatalogDenied: The official BPS catalog reports no models available for this account.
codexBpsCatalogFetched: {{count}} models available in the BPS catalog (fetched {{ago}}); green is available, amber is restricted or cooling down.
codexBpsCatalogAutoSelected: Selected {{count}} models found in the BPS catalog, the site's published models and the account model scope; others were cleared. Save to apply.
codexBpsCatalogUnavailable: These selected models are not in the BPS catalog and will fail over to native: {{models}}
codexBpsOmitToolsHelp: When a request declares hosted tools BPS cannot run (such as web search), omit them and keep using BPS; when off such requests use the native channel.
codexBpsIgnoreEncryptedHelp: When history messages carry encrypted content, drop the ciphertext and keep using BPS; when off such requests use the native channel.
codexBpsCacheAsInputHelp: Cache-write tokens reported by BPS are priced as regular input, and the cache-write usage returned to the caller is 0.
codexBpsAutoDisableHelp: When BPS returns an account-level 403, disable BPS for this account; the native channel is unaffected. When off only that request switches accounts.
codexBpsAutoRecoverHelp: After disabling, send a tiny probe with the first BPS model at each interval and re-enable on success.
codexBpsRateLimitCooldownHelp: How long this account's BPS route pauses after a 429 without a reset time; an upstream Retry-After wins (also limited to 1–600 seconds).
codexBpsAutoMoveHelp: When disabled, move the account into the chosen group and out of all others (once per disable).
codexBpsAddStepHelp: The account was created. Continue with BPS authorization for the same ChatGPT account, or skip and add it later from the account editor.
gatewayWorkerCustodyKeyPending: This instance reported a custody key that differs from the confirmed one (rebuilt data directory, or someone impersonating it). Until confirmed, custody projections use the shared credential bundle. On the Worker's own host, check that the new fingerprint matches its startup log (custody key fingerprint) or a local health request before accepting.
gatewayWorkerCustodyKeyFirst: A new instance reported its first custody key. Until confirmed, custody projections use the shared credential bundle. On the Worker's own host, check that the fingerprint matches its startup log (custody key fingerprint) or a local health request before accepting.
codexPlanOverrideHelp: Manually correct this account's ChatGPT tier (Plus / Pro 100 / Pro 200 / Pro 500 …). Affects panel display only, not the real upstream plan. While set it takes precedence; clear it to return to auto-detection (the tier seen by quota checks, otherwise the tier at authorization).
